papa.label: Papa's book
papa.subject: papa: a stock's dividend years no longer stick on one failed read. BDMS on papa's phone said "No years: network request failed: UnknownHostException ... query1.finance.yahoo.com" until the app was closed, while the Pi-hole answered Yahoo every time (one missed lookup on the phone). The read is asked once more after 1.5 s when the network fails outright, a failure is kept 10 s (was 60), the page asks again when a failed read is 10 s old, and says "Could not get the years just now" with Try again instead of the Java error. years-retry.test 3/3 (red with no retry / the 60 s keep), tracker-div-e2e green (red with no re-ask / the old line); papa 527/527 (the two e2e's --import now a file URL, so they run on Windows)
